name: access_to_host_ports
title: Access to host ports
description: According to pod security standard 'Host Ports', hostPorts should be disallowed, or at minimum restricted to a known list.
recommended_action: Do not set spec.containers[*].ports[*].hostPort and spec.initContainers[*].ports[*].hostPort.

name: anonymous_user_bind
title: Anonymous user access binding
description: Binding to anonymous user to any clusterrole or role is a security risk.
recommended_action: Remove anonymous user binding from clusterrolebinding or rolebinding.

name: apparmor_policy_disabled
title: Runtime/Default AppArmor profile not set
description: According to pod security standard 'AppArmor', the AppArmor key must be set to the runtime/default profile or to be undefined.

name: can_elevate_its_own_privileges
title: Can elevate its own privileges
description: A program inside the container can elevate its own privileges and run as root, which might give the program control over the container and node.

name: capabilities_no_drop_all
title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop all
description: The container should drop all default capabilities and add only those that are needed for its execution.

name: capabilities_no_drop_at_least_one
title: Default capabilities: some containers do not drop any
description: Security best practices require containers to run with minimal required capabilities.
recommended_action: Specify at least one unneeded capability in 'containers[].securityContext.capabilities.drop'

name: CPU_not_limited
title: CPU not limited
description: Enforcing CPU limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.

name: CPU_requests_not_specified
title: CPU requests not specified
description: When containers have resource requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.

name: file_system_not_read_only
title: Root file system is not read-only
description: An immutable root file system prevents applications from writing to their local disk. This can limit intrusions, as attackers will not be able to tamper with the file system or write foreign executables to disk.

name: hostpath_volumes_mounted
title: hostPath volumes mounted
description: According to pod security standard 'HostPath Volumes', HostPath volumes must be forbidden.

name: Kubernetes_resource_with_disallowed_volumes_mounted
title: Kubernetes resource with disallowed volumes mounted
description: HostPath present many security risks and as a security practice it is better to avoid critical host paths mounts.
recommended_action: Do not Set 'spec.volumes[*].hostPath.path' to any of the disallowed volumes.

name: manages_etc_hosts
title: Manages /etc/hosts
description: Managing /etc/hosts aliases can prevent the container engine from modifying the file after a pod’s containers have already been started.

name: masters_group_bind
title: system:masters group access binding
description: Binding to system:masters group to any clusterrole or role is a security risk.
recommended_action: Remove system:masters group binding from clusterrolebinding or rolebinding.

name: memory_not_limited
title: Memory not limited
description: Enforcing memory limits prevents DoS via resource exhaustion.

name: memory_requests_not_specified
title: Memory requests not specified
description: When containers have memory requests specified, the scheduler can make better decisions about which nodes to place pods on, and how to deal with resource contention.

name: mounts_docker_socket
title: hostPath volume mounted with docker.sock
description: Mounting docker.sock from the host can give the container full root access to the host.

name: non_core_volume_types
title: Non-core volume types used.
description: According to pod security standard 'Volume types', non-core volume types must not be used.
recommended_action: Do not Set 'spec.volumes[*]' to any of the disallowed volume types.

name: non_default_proc_masks_set
title: Non-default /proc masks set
description: According to pod security standard '/proc Mount Type', the default /proc masks are set up to reduce attack surface, and should be required.

name: privileged
title: Privileged
description: Privileged containers share namespaces with the host system and do not offer any security. They should be used exclusively for system containers that require high privileges.

name: privileged_ports_binding
title: Prevent binding to privileged ports
description: The ports which are lower than 1024 receive and transmit various sensitive and privileged data. Allowing containers to use them can bring serious implications.
recommended_action: Do not map the container ports to privileged host ports when starting a container.

name: runs_as_root
title: Runs as root user
description: Force the running image to run as a non-root user to ensure least privileges.

name: runs_with_a_root_primary_or_supplementary_GID
title: Runs with a root primary or supplementary GID
description: According to pod security standard 'Non-root groups', containers should be forbidden from running with a root primary or supplementary GID.

name: runs_with_GID_le_10000
title: Runs with GID <= 10000
description: Force the container to run with group ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.

name: runs_with_UID_le_10000
title: Runs with UID <= 10000
description: Force the container to run with user ID > 10000 to avoid conflicts with the host’s user table.

name: service_with_externalip
title: Service with External IP
description: Services with external IP addresses allows direct access from the internet and might expose risk for CVE-2020-8554

name: specific_capabilities_added
title: Specific capabilities added
description: According to pod security standard 'Capabilities', capabilities beyond the default set must not be added.

name: use_limit_range
title: limit range usage
description: Ensure that a LimitRange policy is configured to limit resource usage for namespaces or nodes
recommended_action: Create a LimitRange policy with default requests and limits for each container

name: windows_host_process
title: Access to host process
description: Windows pods offer the ability to run HostProcess containers which enable privileged access to the Windows node.
recommended_action: Do not enable 'hostProcess' on any securityContext
